scenario.zh:
刚开始交往不久。
有一次逛街时，对方看到一件很喜欢的东西，但价格超出了你目前的预算。
你更可能会——
scenario.en:
You have only been dating for a short time.
While shopping together, your partner notices something they really like, but it is well beyond your current budget.
What would you most likely think?

text.zh: 我们可能不太合适，我希望找一个物质要求没那么高的人。
text.en: We may not be a good match. I'd rather be with someone who has simpler material expectations.

interpretation.zh: 物质期待的落差，对你来说可能是关系是否匹配的信号。
interpretation.en: A gap in material expectations may read to you as a signal about whether you match.

options.immediate: 用户以物质期待的落差作为关系筛选条件。

text.zh: 喜欢好一点的生活很正常，只要不是盲目攀比，我可以理解。
text.en: Wanting a better lifestyle is perfectly normal, as long as it isn't about showing off.

interpretation.zh: 你可能把「想要更好」和「攀比」分开看——前者可以理解。
interpretation.en: You may separate wanting something better from showing off — and accept the first.

options.immediate: 用户对伴侣的物质向往持接纳态度，同时警惕攀比。

text.zh: 有多大能力，就过什么样的生活。能力范围内，我愿意尽量满足她（他）。
text.en: We should live within our means. If I can afford it, I'd be happy to make them happy.

interpretation.zh: 你可能把给予放在能力边界之内——稳，也愿意。
interpretation.en: You may keep giving inside what you can afford — steady, and still willing.

options.immediate: 用户以能力边界约束给予，同时愿意在边界内满足对方。

text.zh: 我会记住她（他）喜欢的东西，等以后条件允许了，再送给她（他）。
text.en: I'll remember it and buy it for them one day when the time is right.

interpretation.zh: 你可能不急着现在兑现——把心意留到以后能给的时候。
interpretation.en: You may not need to give it now — you hold the wish until you can.

options.immediate: 用户以延迟兑现的方式表达长期关照。

text.zh: 这会让我更有动力，希望以后能给她（他）更好的生活。
text.en: It would motivate me to work harder so I can give us a better future.

interpretation.zh: 对方的愿望，对你来说可能更像一脚油门，而不是压力本身。
interpretation.en: Their wish may feel more like fuel than pressure — something that pushes you forward.

options.immediate: 用户把伴侣的物质愿望转化为自我驱动与未来投入。
